subject: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carelabs.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover

Samir —

Thanks again for committing to the POC. As discussed in the kickoff, I put together a concise MAP slice focused on environment access and the cutover window so we can hit a live test by the end of next week. This note covers only the infra and credentials lane (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering).

Key milestones (owners / target dates):
- Org + tenant creation (CareLabs) — owner: CareLabs ops; target: Tue 2027-02-22
- API keys issuance (read/test) — owner: Redwood (Ava) — target: Wed 2027-02-23
- IP allowlist (static egress ranges) — owner: CareLabs infra — target: Wed 2027-02-23
- VPC peering request + route table changes — owner: CareLabs infra + Redwood network ops (Marissa) — target: Thu 2027-02-24
- Cutover / smoke test (10:00 PT) — owner: joint — target: Fri 2027-02-25

Blocking items we need from you this week:
1) Confirmation of the tenant admin email for org creation.
2) Public IP ranges to add to allowlist (or confirmation you’ll use the shared NAT ranges in the vpc-peering-reqs.txt attached).
3) Procurement timeline for MSA/signature — if legal needs a redline window we can hold the keys until we have a signature, but we can issue test keys earlier if helpful.

Marissa and Evelyn — looping you for peering and credential ops; I flagged the required peering checklist in the vpc-peering-reqs.txt attached. If anything looks off, call it out and we’ll push dates.

Next step: Samir, can you confirm tenant admin and whether procurement will block issuing test keys? If yes, reply with the expected signature date and contact at Procure Inc.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (stub) — brief security overview
Attachment: vpc-peering-reqs.txt (stub)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carelabs.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover

Hi Ava,

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: tenant admin should be samir.patel@carelabs.io. We can provide the IP ranges — attaching our egress ranges and a short network contact.

Procurement: Procure Inc (our procurement partner) will need a signed MSA. I’ve looped our procurement rep (procure@procureinc.com) and legal (legal@carelabs.io). They’ve requested the MSA redline. I don’t think the signature will block issuing test keys — we can accept ephemeral/test keys for dev work while legal completes the MSA.

Questions:
- What is the TTL/scope on the test keys? Will they be usable for embeddings and chat generation calls (read-only vs. generation limits)?
- Any specific firewall ports or protocols we should open beyond standard HTTPS (443)?

I’ve attached our egress list as requested.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform — CareLabs
samir.patel@carelabs.io

Attachment: carelabs-egress-ranges.txt (stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 12:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover

Forwarding Samir’s note — tagging network ops for timeline confirmation.

Marissa — can you confirm the route table change window and whether our peer acceptance requires a ticket for the cloud infra team? I expect the route propagation will be fast but want to schedule the exact time.

Also: Ava — we should prepare an expiration policy on test keys and a scoped role (embedding + generation at low qps). I suggest: 72-hour test key TTL, rate-limited to 5 rps and token limits per minute. If CareLabs needs higher throughput for the smoke test, we can temporarily raise limits for the cutover window.

E

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, legal@carelabs.io, procure@procureinc.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover

Thanks — looping in Redwood legal & procurement for the MSA redline so we can get signatures on schedule. Procurement: I attached our suggested redline (MSA_redline_Procure.pdf stub) and a short checklist for peering acceptance.

Action items for procurement/legal (Procure Inc / CareLabs legal):
- Review MSA redline and flag material concerns by EOD Tue 2027-02-23.
- If redline accepted, sign via DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/contract/79a3b (shared below).

Network ops notes (internal):
- Per Samir’s egress ranges, peering request is standard (no special ports beyond 443). We will need a maintenance window on Thu 02/24 to update route tables — propose 02:00–03:00 PT to reduce app impact.
- Confirmed attachment: vpc-peering-reqs.txt (stub) — includes subnet/ASN details.

If procurement needs keys blocked until the signature, confirm via reply and we will hold issuance of production keys but can still issue ephemeral test keys (72h TTL).

Marissa
Network Ops Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MSA_redline_Procure.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carelabs.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, procure@procureinc.com, legal@carelabs.io
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC credential orchestration & peering cutover — final confirmation

Samir / team — quick sync to confirm items and lock the cutover: 

Resolved:
- Tenant admin: samir.patel@carelabs.io (confirmed).
- Egress ranges received and matched against vpc-peering-reqs.txt.
- Network maintenance window agreed: Thu 2027-02-24 02:00–03:00 PT for route table updates.
- Test keys: issuing scoped ephemeral test API key today (72h TTL, embedding+generation enabled, 5 rps soft limit). Keys will be posted in the CareLabs tenant (Ava will DM the secret).

Open:
- MSA signature: procurement/legal to confirm by EOD Tue 2027-02-23. If signed, we will convert the test key to a production key with standard retention and billing. If not signed, the test key will expire and we’ll coordinate a re-issue for the cutover if needed.

Next steps (owners):
- Ava: issue test key and DM secret to samir.patel@carelabs.io (today).
- Marissa: execute peering maintenance window and confirm route propagation (Thu 02/24 morning).
- Samir: confirm acceptance after smoke test (Fri 02/25 10:00 PT).

Thanks everyone — pushing to keep the MAP lane tight so CareLabs can start evaluation traffic next week.

Ava
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
